description: This file defines utility functions for reading, writing, and validating sections within text files, specifically for merging netlist files. It includes methods for file I/O operations and section syntax validation.

classes.name: NetListMergeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for reading, writing, and validating sections in netlist files for the rusefi project.

methods.name: writeResult
methods.description: Writes the given content to a specified file.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a String.

methods.name: checkExistence
methods.description: Checks if a file exists; if not, outputs an error and terminates the program.

methods.name: validateSection
methods.description: Validates that a section string has balanced parentheses.
